description: Search receipt-linked US government financial disclosures: both chambers of Congress under the STOCK Act, plus executive-branch OGE filings (chamber 'executive', which holds the President's disclosures). Every row carries receipt.url, the government's own document for that row: a PDF page for House and OGE filings, or the Senate eFD report page, which the Senate site opens behind its own access agreement (receipt.access 'gated'). Supports point-in-time reconstruction via as_of (rows observed on or before that timestamp; no look-ahead bias) and change polling via updated_since. Free access covers filings from the last 30 days. Developer covers the last 12 months, or 90 days for OGE filings. page.next_cursor continues within that window. See https://www.veridionmarkets.com/api/v1/openapi.json for full response fields.

as_of.description: ISO timestamp: only rows first observed on/before this instant

chamber.description: Filter by filing body. 'house' and 'senate' are STOCK Act periodic transaction reports; 'executive' is executive-branch OGE filings, which is where the President's disclosures are. Omit to search all.

cursor.description: Opaque page.next_cursor from a previous call

limit.description: Rows per page: 10 when omitted, up to 25 on Free and 100 with a Developer key.

member_id.description: Filter to one filer by slug, e.g. donald-trump or nancy-pelosi. The same slug appears as member.member_id on every row.

min_delay_days.description: Only rows filed at least this many days after the transaction. The STOCK Act window is 45 days, so 46 returns filings outside it. Rows without a computed delay are excluded, not guessed at.

ticker.description: Filter by ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA

updated_since.description: ISO timestamp: only rows first observed after this instant

within_statutory_window.description: false returns only filings made outside the statutory window that applies to that row (served as statutory_window_days); true returns only filings inside it. Unlike min_delay_days, the boundary is each row's own window rather than a supplied number. Annual reports have no window and are excluded by either value.

name: search_disclosures
